ctaHeading: Need electrical supplies in Adelaide? Let's power your project.
aboutText: Sherriff Electrical Wholesaler has been Adelaide's trusted supplier for over 28 years, offering an extensive range of electrical products from top brands like Clipsal, Schneider, and Hager. Our experienced team provides tailored advice to electricians, contractors, and businesses, ensuring you find everything from everyday fittings to specialized industrial components. We pride ourselves on reliable service and deep local knowledge across South Australia.
servicesText: We stock a comprehensive selection of electrical supplies, including switches, sockets, lighting, cable, and industrial gear. Our inventory covers domestic, commercial, and industrial needs, with products from leading manufacturers to guarantee quality and performance.

services.title: Switches & Sockets
services.desc: Wide variety of powerpoints, dimmers, and smart switches for residential and commercial installations.

services.title: Lighting Solutions
services.desc: Downlights, batten fittings, emergency lights, and outdoor lighting to suit any space or project.

services.title: Cable & Wiring
services.desc: Building wire, data cable, solar cable, and specialty wires for automotive and industrial applications.

services.title: Industrial Equipment
services.desc: Robust switchgear, motor control, enclosures, and safety components for heavy-duty use.

services.title: Air Conditioning Supplies
services.desc: Ducting, insulation, controllers, and accessories for split systems and ducted air conditioning.

services.title: Safety & Automation
services.desc: Smoke alarms, home automation, test equipment, and compliance gear for modern electrical work.
